text:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down the customer-facing comms checklist and action-item tracker for last week's outage. Can we confirm owners + timelines?
AJ: Yep. I have the action tracker draft, but want sign-off on the status page wording before I push it.
Sophie: I skimmed the template, there's one line about "ongoing investigation" that Legal flagged as risky last time.
Legal: Confirmed — we should avoid wording that implies ongoing root cause if we don't have evidence. Use neutral language + next-steps and ETA for a follow-up.
Maria: Good call. Ops-bot: note for record, postmortem created, incident# 2026-08-17-01.
AJ: Draft snippet for status page (proposed):
```
We experienced degraded request success rates in the US-West region between 03:42–04:10 UTC. We mitigated the impact by rolling back a config change; customer requests are now routing correctly. Follow-up: a full incident summary and RCA will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Sophie: I suggest replacing "rolling back a config change" with "a targeted rollback of a configuration pushed earlier" — slightly less prescriptive.
Legal: Also swap "RCA will be posted within 72 hours" to "an incident summary and RCA will be shared by <date/time>" with a concrete timestamp for customers. That reduces ambiguity.
Maria: Action: AJ to update status page wording to Legal-approved phrasing, due by EOD today.
AJ: On it.
Maria: Next — customer-facing incident summary. We need a short paragraph for the support ticket template and a longer public summary for the status page follow-up.
AJ: Proposed support-ticket paragraph (short):
"We observed increased error rates affecting some API requests. The issue was mitigated by reverting a recent config change. We are conducting a detailed RCA and will follow up with any customer impact analysis. Estimated delivery: 2026-08-20 16:00 UTC."
Sophie: For public summary, include what customers can/do need to do (if anything). In this case, none. Add a "what we did" + "what we're doing" section.
Maria: Agreed. Also need to decide on RCA sharing policy: direct sharing of full RCA vs redacted summary. Current pattern has been: internal RCA + redacted customer summary. Any objections?
Legal: No objections, but we need a clear redaction checklist: (1) internal IP/service names, (2) exact rollback commands, (3) personnel identifiers. Provide that checklist to Customers when asked for more detail.
Jason: From support side — customers sometimes ask for timeline + logs. If we offer a redacted RCA, can we include a sanitized timeline (to the minute) and an executive summary? That usually satisfies them.
Maria: That sounds fine. Let's codify: default = public redacted RCA + optional sanitized timeline on request. Explicit requests go to Customer Success with Legal sign-off.
AJ: I'll add a short paragraph to the action tracker under "Comms policy".
Maria: Action list (quick):
- AJ: Update status page wording and post public summary draft — due 2026-08-17 23:59 UTC.
- Legal: Send redaction checklist and a one-paragraph guidance note for CS — due 2026-08-18 12:00 UTC.
- Sophie: Draft the public incident summary (what happened, mitigation, customer impact, follow-ups) and attach to the postmortem — due 2026-08-18 12:00 UTC.
- Jason: Prepare a sanitized timeline template for CS to use when customers request more detail — due 2026-08-18 16:00 UTC.
- Maria: Verify action tracker is updated and owner tags applied, then mark postmortem follow-up as "in progress" — due 2026-08-18 18:00 UTC.
Sophie: Can we add a recurring check for patterns? This is the third config-related regression in the last 6 months. We should surface that to infra eng for a pattern review.
Maria: Yes — add an "incident pattern" agenda item for the monthly reliability review and assign to Infrastructure PM.
AJ: Quick practical Q: do we want the status page snippet to include an apology line? Some customers like that.
Legal: Apology language is fine if it's concise and not admitting liability. E.g., "We apologize for the disruption this caused" is ok.
Maria: Final: AJ will post the updated status page and reply here with the link. Once Legal + Sophie sign off, Customer Success will send a brief customer note with the redacted RCA link.
AJ: I'll post the link when live. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Updated tracker: postmortem 2026-08-17-01 follow-ups created by Maria.
Jason: Thanks — I'll sync with CS so they know to route requests to Legal for detailed RCAs.
Maria: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, ping me here. :eyes:
